subject: openclaw
tagline: Personal-agent OS: workspace identity files, multi-root skills, native plugins, and ClawHub.

capabilities.name: Workspace constitution
capabilities.description: AGENTS/SOUL/USER/IDENTITY/MEMORY split; subagents get AGENTS.md only. clawd is the reference home.

capabilities.name: Multi-root skill load
capabilities.description: Workspace > .agents > ~/.agents > state > bundled > plugin; catalog capped (150 / 18k chars).

capabilities.name: Native plugin architecture
capabilities.description: Manifest validated before executing plugin code; exclusive slots for memory/context-engine.

capabilities.name: Skill Workshop + ClawHub
capabilities.description: Human gate before agent-written skills go live; marketplace verify/scan.

capabilities.name: TaskFlow durable jobs
capabilities.description: stateJson + currentStep for multi-step work; business logic stays in the caller.

capabilities.name: Requires gating
capabilities.description: metadata.openclaw.requires.bins/env/os so missing binaries do not pollute the catalog.

unique_selling_points: Richest native plugin model in the set
Identity files are not skills and not policy

limitations.description: Not an SDLC methodology — standing orders + TaskFlow, not specify→plan→ship
No org-chart / company budget plane (that's Paperclip's job)
